correctness.rationale: Stationary recurrence roots and periodization reconstruct the normalized invariant distribution. The exact ratio R_j of negative to positive hopping terms has a strictly negative h-derivative after removing the root exponent; for the other half its x-derivative is strictly negative and endpoints are 0 and infinity. R_{j+1}/R_j=h/x^2>1 establishes strict order, and finite-state perturbation establishes the weak-bias law. Independent exact-rational stationary solves and numerical bisection pass 180 test families; finite tests are corroborative, not a proof for arbitrary n.
